description: 河川分署管轄範圍圖 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 本資料集係連結到KML(Keyhole Markup Language)檔案清冊，該格式是基於XML（eXtensible Markup Language,可擴展標記語言）語法標準的一種標記語言（markup language），採用標記結構，含有嵌套的元素和屬性。 由Google旗下的Keyhole公司發展並維護，用來表達地理標記。 根... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
